purpose: FINAL PASS Wave B6 residual misc: high-value permanent skilling unlocks still missing from data/research/regional-skilling-unlocks.json after waves 1–5. Targets Daemonheim scroll-of-quick-teleportation (named on shop hub only), combat/essence rune-pouch craft ladder beyond grasping alone, Thaler/Stanley Limelight skilling-reward sink hub, and POF farm totems + tier-2 dual-pen perk package. Skips pure TH/oddments consumable spam (cinder cores / pulse cores).

policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary geography. required_regions lists hard gates; optional_pressure_regions are support only. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global tokens in region_hint.
policy.duplicate_guard: Grep-confirmed ABSENT as first-class ids before write: forinthry:scroll-of-quick-teleportation, cross-region:rune-pouch-ladder, cross-region:thaler-skilling-rewards, kandarin:pof-farm-totems-tier2. PRESENT siblings not re-emitted: cross-region:grasping-rune-pouch, forinthry:magical-thread-abyss-supply, forinthry:daemonheim-rewards-shop-hub, forinthry:scroll-of-life/cleansing/efficiency/etc., kandarin:pof-breeding-log-tier1-perks, kandarin:farmers-market-master-farmer, asgarnia:flash-powder-factory-herblore-outfits, misthalin:fletchers-outfit, kandarin:diviners-outfit.
skip_not_permanent: cross-region:cinder-and-pulse-cores — both are stackable pocket consumables (TH/oddments/DXP token store); burn Bonus XP / grant temporary XP and skill boosts then explode. Not account-state permanents. Ironman core economy is supply spam, not a regional unlock. SKIP per final-pass rule.
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman permanent account unlocks, shop hubs that convert minigame time into permanent skilling gear, and POF infrastructure that enables tier-2 animal perks.
policy.rate_rule: No invented XP/hour. Unlock state, token/bean/thaler costs, effects, and region pressure only.
policy.combo_fields: Every multi-region row sets region_hints, required_regions, optional_pressure_regions, region_requirement_type, and links_existing_ids.

equipment_additions.name: Scroll of quick teleportation (Daemonheim permanent)
requirements: Purchase from Marmaros (Daemonheim Rewards) or historically Wythien (Prifddinas Daemonheim Rewards shop)
Read the scroll once — item is consumed on unlock
unlocks: Permanent account unlock: quick version of Dungeon Home Teleport while inside a Dungeoneering floor (includes Sinkholes)
Quick cast does not work in combat
Counts toward Scrolling with Power (trimmed completionist cape scroll trait set) with the other Daemonheim scrolls
region_pressure: Forinthry owns Daemonheim camp, token economy, and primary Marmaros shop — same gate as other named scrolls.
Tirannwn optional: Prif shop convenience only after Plague's End; not a second hard gate.
equipment_additions.notes: Named on forinthry:daemonheim-rewards-shop-hub unlock list but never emitted as a dedicated permanent row unlike life/cleansing/efficiency/gathering/proficiency/dexterity/restoration/renewal. Parity fix only — do not invent surface-world teleport effects.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Forinthry for Daemonheim tokens and rewards shop.

activity_additions.name: Rune pouch craft ladder (large → grasping + expansive essence path)
requirements: 90 Runecrafting to craft sealed large rune pouch (100 magical threads via Abyss RC — forinthry:magical-thread-abyss-supply)
66 Magic to equip/use large rune pouch (3 non-necrotic rune types)
Grasping upgrade: 90 RC craft, 85 Magic use, large/sealed large base + 15 magical threads + 2,000 Croesus flakes (cross-region:grasping-rune-pouch)

Optional expansive essence pouch (separate essence-storage line, not combat rune pouch): 105 Runecrafting + 95 Divination unboostable for craft; Hungry hood 20k Runespan + full small→massive pouch set + Ilme's thread + 100 magical thread + leather/felt/sign components; final fill at Rune Essence mine
unlocks: Planner-visible combat rune pouch ladder: sealed/large (100 thread) → grasping (4 types + 25% combat rune save + prayer bonus)
Does not re-author grasping effects — links cross-region:grasping-rune-pouch as the finished combat pouch checklist
Optional expansive essence pouch: permanent non-degrading 70-essence storage (replaces multi-pouch inventory tax; cannot use other essence pouches while one is active for fill/empty)
Ironman self-source map: Abyss thread (Forinthry) + Croesus flakes (Morytania) for grasping; Runespan + essence mine (Misthalin tower pressure) for expansive
region_pressure: Forinthry hard-owns Abyss magical-thread rates and is the shared material root for large, grasping, and expansive cord.
Morytania optional-hard for grasping (Croesus flakes) — score as required only when the planner goal is grasping, not large-only.
Misthalin optional: Wizards' Tower Runespan shop / essence mine for expansive path.
Anachronia optional: dinosaur leather component on shielded pouch exterior for expansive.
activity_additions.notes: cross-region:grasping-rune-pouch already first-class for the combat end-product. This ladder exists because sealed/large craft and expansive essence pouch were only footnotes under magical-thread supply. Expansive pouch is essence storage (2025 RC update), not a fourth combat-rune slot pouch — keep terminology distinct. Do not invent stack caps or save rates beyond wiki.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Forinthry for Abyss thread. Add Morytania when scoring grasping. Expansive is multi-support (Misthalin tower + material regions).

activity_additions.name: Thaler skilling rewards hub (Stanley Limelight Traders)
activity_additions.category: global minigame currency skilling-outfit sink hub
requirements: Earn Thaler from the 13 Minigame Spotlight-eligible games (1 thaler / 5 minutes baseline; 1 / minute on spotlight world)
Spend at Stanley Limelight Traders (NPC at eligible minigame entrances — multi-site shop, same stock)
Ironman-eligible stock for most combat/minigame rewards; some skilling gloves historically ironman-blocked — prefer outfit rows already catalogued for activity-native currencies when both paths exist
unlocks: Planner-visible Thaler sink for permanent XP-boosting skilling outfit pieces sold at Stanley Limelight (wiki stock includes Fletcher's, Farmer's, Diviner's, Artisan's, Blacksmith's, Botanist's, Sous chef's, Shaman's, First age sets — typically 360 thaler per piece where listed)
Silverhawk boots (750 thaler) and Silverhawk down x10 (35 thaler) as Agility supply alternate to other paths

Does not re-emit outfit effect rows already first-class (misthalin:fletchers-outfit, asgarnia:flash-powder-factory-herblore-outfits / Botanist's Brian-point path, kandarin:diviners-outfit, etc.) — this is the currency hub + geography scoring row
Spotlight rotation lets ironmen farm any of the 13 games rather than a single minigame ticket currency
region_pressure: Thaler is account-global; region pressure is which minigames the player can enter under league/region locks.
Asgarnia: Flash Powder Factory, Pest Control, Fist of Guthix / Gamers' Grotto adjacency — strong default hub for ironman thaler.
Kandarin: Fishing Trawler, Castle Wars-adjacent pressure.
Misthalin: Stealing Creation / Heist / Conquest-style Gamers' Grotto cluster.
activity_additions.notes: Outfits already note Thaler alternate paths without a first-class sink id (wave-5 rank 25). Hub only — do not invent full set totals beyond per-piece wiki prices. Prefer native activity currencies (Brian points for factory, beans for farmer pieces where applicable) when both exist; Thaler is the multi-minigame escape hatch.
activity_additions.league_treatment: No single hard region — score optional pressure from which spotlight minigames the unlocked regions contain. Asgarnia is the richest default ironman thaler geography.

activity_additions.name: POF farm totems + tier-2 dual-pen animal perks
requirements: Player-owned Farm unlocked (Manor Farm tutorial — 17 Farming + 20 Construction)
200 beans per farm totem from Farmers' Market (Granny Potterington) or Ranch Out of Time market (Prehistoric Potterington) — up to 10 totems account-wide (enough for every non-breeding pen hotspot)
Tier-1 active perk: elder animal in a pen with a placed totem (breeding-log completion also grants passive tier-1 without totems — kandarin:pof-breeding-log-tier1-perks)
Tier-2 perk: elders of the same species in two separate pens, each with a farm totem — breeding log does NOT grant tier-2
unlocks: Account can place/move farm totems on Manor Farm and Ranch Out of Time pen hotspots (breeding pens have no hotspot)
Tier-1 animal-family perks while elders + totem active (examples: chinchompa skillchompa save, zygomite mushroom yield, cow churn XP, yak clue chance — full table on wiki Farm totem)
Tier-2 stronger perk variants when dual-pen + dual-totem conditions met (e.g. skillchompa save 3%→5%, rabbit breeding success 7%→10%)
Anachronia dinosaur pen perks (arcane runes-per-essence, geode chance, BGH meat, etc.) use the same totem items
region_pressure: Kandarin hard-owns Manor Farm hub, default Farmers' Market, and most mid-game animal pens.
Anachronia optional: Ranch Out of Time pens and dinosaur-family perks; beans are account-wide across both markets.
activity_additions.notes: kandarin:pof-breeding-log-tier1-perks explicitly footnotes that tier-2 still needs dual pens + totems. This row is that missing permanent infrastructure. Totems are unique bean purchases (destroy warning: cannot reclaim) — treat as permanent farm state, not consumable spam. Do not invent perk percentages beyond wiki tier tables.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Kandarin for Manor Farm + market. Anachronia only if dinosaur tier-2 perks are the scoring target.
